{"metadata":{"description":"Embedded Overleaf workbench tab for DeepSeek Harness Web: same-origin reverse proxy, direct-CDP login, selection quoting, caret insertion, LaTeX assist panel","id":"gh:1348483309","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-overleaf","slug":"gychen-NJU/dsh-overleaf","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Embedded Overleaf workbench tab for DeepSeek Harness Web: same-origin reverse proxy, direct-CDP logi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"n, selection quoting, caret insertion, LaTeX assist panel"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-overleaf"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An embedded **Overleaf workbench** plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web. It adds a fourth tab next "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"to `Chat / Trajectory / Context` on the session page: the tab loads your Overleaf site (public cloud"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" or self-hosted such as `https://tex.nju.edu.cn`) through a same-origin reverse proxy, so the page r"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"enders and **stays fully operable** — editing, compiling, PDF preview — while the native DSH compose"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"r stays below it, with selection quoting, caret insertion, and LaTeX assist panels wired between the"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"ys below it, with selection quoting, caret insertion, and LaTeX assist panels wired between the two."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- License: MIT
- Version: **1.0.0** — milestone release: adapted to DSH 0.1.7's plugin configuration"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" contract (volatile hot-editable fields + Plugins page configuration seats) and consolidating the Te"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"XPage (`tex.nju.edu.cn`) two-site support
- Target runtime: DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2`, web profi"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"le (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`); the peer ranges still accept host services from 0.1.0-rc.5 on, where t"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"he legacy settings entry is used
- Protocol: ships a static Community v0.15 `dsh-plugin.json` per th"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"e dsh-std interoperability spec; classic dual-face bundle loading remains the primary activation pat"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"dsh-std interoperability spec; classic dual-face bundle loading remains the primary activation path."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why it exists"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Overleaf sends `X-Frame-Options` / CSP `frame-ancestors` on every response, so a plain `<iframe src="},{"id":"p8s2","text":""https://tex.nju.edu.cn">` is refused by browsers. This plugin ships an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy insid"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e the DSH host process: all browser traffic goes to `/overleaf-proxy/<original-path>` which forwards"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" to your configured upstream origin — one fixed origin, locked by configuration, no open SSRF surfac"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"e. Because the iframe and the GUI then share one origin, browser-level bridges become possible: text"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" selections flow out of the embedded editor into the composer as structured quotes, and generated co"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ntent can be written back at the editor caret."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Feature map (spec coverage)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Requirement | Status |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| R1 · fourth session-page tab | `conversation.view` entry `id:"overleaf"`, `order:30`; visible when"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ever the tab bar shows (`tabs >= 2`) |
| R2 · configurable site address | Settings page (DSH 0.1.7+:"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" the "Overleaf workbench settings" page in the Settings sidebar, or sidebar → Plugins → Installed → "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"dsh-overleaf; older lines: Settings > Plugins > Plugin configuration) edits `baseUrl`; saving hot-sw"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"aps the proxy target without a restart |
| R3 · original site features usable | Streaming reverse pr"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"oxy preserves paths and query strings; responses pass through minus framing headers; small HTML bodi"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"es get link/asset rebasing plus the bridge script |
| R4 · native composer below | The view replaces"},{"id":"p11s8","text":" only the message area; composer, workspace recording, deliverables untouched |
| R5 · selection quo"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ting | `selectionchange` in the iframe surfaces a floating quote button; clicking inserts a structur"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"ed quote chip through the official reference pipeline (`inputTriggers.registerSource({name:'quote-re"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"f'})` codec), falling back to plain-text block quotes when absent |
| R6 · generate at caret | Templ"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"ate inserts and free-form/agent-generated LaTeX write to the live cursor through CodeMirror APIs (CM"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"5 primary, CM6 probe, editable fallback); agent output is captured into a review box before insertio"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"n |
| R7 · assist features | Assist panel: AI writing; selection questions and reviewed replacement "},{"id":"p11s15","text":"(safe checks by default, explicit force mode available); safe local `.bib` synchronization; bidirect"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"ional current Overleaf/workspace `.tex` synchronization (Overleaf-to-local by default, explicit conf"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"irmation and revision checks for reverse whole-document replacement); reviewed compile-log fixes; do"},{"id":"p11s18","text":"cument outline navigation; login/logout/cookie management; status reporting |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- All plugin routes are loopback-fenced at the socket level (`127.0.0.1`/`::1`); non-loopback caller"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s get 403 before handlers read bodies.
- The proxy targets exactly one configured origin — URL parsi"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ng rejects scheme/path/host overrides, so there is no open relay surface.
- Framing protections are "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"relaxed only for this user-chosen upstream, served to loopback clients that deliberately asked for i"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"t; headers are otherwise preserved.
- Treat `baseUrl` like any tool allowed to hold your LaTeX accou"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"nt session: configure private/internal Overleaf instances only if your workstation is the trust boun"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"dary.
- Cookies are forwarded but never echoed in API responses; logout removes the stored credentia"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"l immediately.
- The embedded page runs with your GUI's origin; scripts served from the upstream run"},{"id":"p13s9","text":" there too. Review what you embed accordingly."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Cookies carry their upstream flags: `Secure` cookies are accepted over `http://127.0.0.1:3080` on "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"modern Chrome/Firefox/Edge because loopback is trustworthy, but old browsers may drop them; host-sid"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e injection still works regardless.
- Exact WS match means client code must reach `/overleaf-proxy/s"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ocket.io[/]` — the bridge wrapper rewrites the standard paths; exotic transports bypassing it fall b"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ack to polling.
- Pure-client frameworks that compute URLs after load are covered by wrappers and `<"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"base>`; anything opening sockets outside these paths needs manual routing rules.
- CM6 support probe"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"s common handle locations; should Overleaf finish its CM6 migration with different internals, templa"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"te inserts degrade to the editable-focus fallback.
- A blank vs repeated render on some public-cloud"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" project pages may need rebase tweaks per instance version; enable `DSH_OVERLEAF_DEBUG=1` on the hos"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"t to log stripped CSP frames."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Compatibility notes"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Verified against DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` web profile (including 0.1.7's volatile settings forms, the Plug"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ins page keyed configuration seats and the `loader/volatile-update` hot-apply contract); peer ranges"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" accept `>=0.1.0-rc.5` for host services and cordis `^4.0.1`, and older harness generations use the "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"legacy settings seat with `settingsScope` — the feature set is unchanged there.
- Node `^22.19 || >="},{"id":"p17s5","text":"24`.
- Works alongside `dsh-better-sidebar`/`dsh-better-overleaf`/`dsh-context`/`paperlab` et al.; s"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ee the coexistence table.
- `dsh-plugin.json` follows dsh-std Community v0.15; hosts implementing `@"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"dsh-std/adapter-dsh` discover the manifest statically, while ordinary profiles simply ignore it."}],"truncated":true}
